decides: nothing beyond this publication; the live record and the live pin are not read or changed
record: the published distribution with the calendar-adjusted middle band (conformal_pid_calendar), every scored day at h = 1

settings.ruling_item: (d) the conformal-PID calendar scorecaster (Angelopoulos, Candes & Tibshirani)
settings.what: the issued vector with each interior level moved by an integrator plus a calendar scorecaster. Integrator: theta_tau += 0.05 * (tau - 1[y < final q_tau issued that day]) over earlier days whose label is observable at the anchor, in date order (the paper's I term; the P term is not used). Scorecaster: the tau-quantile of (y - (issued q_tau + theta_tau as it stood that day)) over the trailing-250 observable days of the scored day's calendar class ('turn' or 'ordinary', as conformal_by_day_type), 0 while that class has fewer than 60 observable days; the final q_tau is issued + theta_tau + scorecaster. The vector is sorted

sign_convention: gain = CRPS(published) - CRPS(candidate) per day; a positive mean favours the candidate
